title: Refusal messages name the fix
description: Unsupported-type and RSA-size refusals from ssh_to_did say what is wrong but not what to do; most people meet the rule here, not in the README. Append: make a new key with: ssh-keygen -t ed25519-sk.
acceptance_criteria: Both refusals end with the ssh-keygen hint; a CLI test checks it on real ssh-keygen keys
